content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 21-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) under the IITD/IRD/263/2026 advertisement number.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The post available in this recruitment notification is Research Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Assistant post in this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E / B.Tech in Computer Science/Information Technology with experience in Python Language and Data Annotation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary offered for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Assistant position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 32,500.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Nil. There is no application fee required for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting applications by email is 21-10-2026. Candidates must ensure they apply before this deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for IIT Delhi Research Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly through email. Candidates need to send their bio-data and necessary documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of initial shortlisting of candidates followed by an online interview for the shortlisted applicants.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website of IIT Delhi IRD?
faq.answer: You can visit the official IIT Delhi IRD website at http://ird.iitd.ac.in for detailed information regarding the notification and updates.
